title: A versioned struct
description:
Use the `cbSize` pattern so old and new callers can share one function.

```
old caller (size 8):   filled 2 fields
new caller (size 16):  filled 4 fields
size 4:                ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER
```
hints: Copy `cbSize` out with `std::memcpy` first, then compare it with `sizeof(InfoV1)` and `sizeof(InfoV2)` (lesson 3.04).
`offsetof(InfoV2, height) + sizeof(std::uint32_t) <= size` tells whether a field fits.
requirements: `struct InfoV1 { std::uint32_t cbSize; std::uint32_t width; }` and `InfoV2` with two more fields after them.
`bool getInfo(void* info)` reads `cbSize` first and fills only the fields that fit.
Refuse a size smaller than version 1.
stretch: Add a version 3 and check that both old callers still work unchanged.
